```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(modelsummary)

all_data <- read.csv('bobbleheads.csv')
mets_data <- subset(all_data, home_team == "New York Mets")
mets_data
```

# FIGURE 7.1
```{r}
mets_data$ordered_day_of_week <- with(data=mets_data,
                                    ifelse ((day_of_week == "Monday"),1,
                                            ifelse ((day_of_week == "Tuesday"),2,
                                                    ifelse ((day_of_week == "Wednesday"),3,
                                                            ifelse ((day_of_week == "Thursday"),4,
                                                                    ifelse ((day_of_week == "Friday"),5,
                                                                            ifelse ((day_of_week == "Saturday"),6,7)))))))
mets_data$ordered_day_of_week <- factor(mets_data$ordered_day_of_week, levels=1:7,
                                      labels=c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thur", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"))


with(data=mets_data,plot(ordered_day_of_week, attend/1000,
                       xlab = "Day of Week", ylab = "Attendance (thousands)",
                       col = "violet", las = 1))
```

# FIGURE 7.2
```{r}
mets_data$ordered_month <- with(data=mets_data,
                                ifelse ((month == "APR"),4,
                                        ifelse ((month == "MAY"),5,
                                                ifelse ((month == "JUN"),6,
                                                        ifelse ((month == "JUL"),7,
                                                                ifelse ((month == "AUG"),8,
                                                                        ifelse ((month == "SEP"),9,10)))))))
mets_data$ordered_month <- factor(mets_data$ordered_month, levels=4:10,
                                  labels = c("April", "May", "June", "July", "Aug", "Sept", "Oct"))

with(data=mets_data,plot(ordered_month, attend/1000,
                         xlab = "Month", ylab = "Attendance (thousands)",
                         col = "lightblue", las = 1))
```

# TABLE 7.2
```{r}
my.model <- {attend ~ ordered_month + ordered_day_of_week + bobblehead}
my.model.fit <- lm(my.model, data = mets_data)# use all available data
(summary(my.model.fit))

modelsummary(list("New York Mets" = my.model.fit),
             stars = TRUE, gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "adj.r.squared"))
```

# REFACTORED FIGURE 7.1
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)

all_data <- read.csv('bobbleheads.csv')
mets_data <- subset(all_data, home_team == "New York Mets")
mets_data

# Figure 7.1

order <- c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
mets_data <- mets_data |> mutate(day_of_week = factor(day_of_week, levels = order))

ggplot(mets_data, aes(x = day_of_week, y = attend/1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = 'violet') +
  labs(
    title="Mets Game Attendance by Day of Week",
    subtitle = '2012 Season Data',
    x = "Day",
    y = "Attendance (thousands)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()
```

# REFACTORED FIGURE 7.2
```{r}
order <- c("APR", "MAY", "JUN", "JUL", "AUG", "SEP", "OCT")
mets_data <- mets_data |> mutate(month = factor(month, levels = order,
                                 labels = c("April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October")))

ggplot(mets_data, aes(x = month, y = attend/1000)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = 'lightblue') +
  labs(
    title="Mets Game Attendance by Month",
    subtitle = '2012 Season Data',
    x = "Month",
    y = "Attendance (thousands)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()
```

# FULL MLB FIGURE 7.1

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(modelsummary)

all_data <- read.csv('bobbleheads.csv')
mets_data <- subset(all_data, home_team == "New York Mets")

order <- c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
mets_data <- mets_data |> mutate(day_of_week = factor(day_of_week, levels = order))
all_data <- all_data |> mutate(day_of_week = factor(day_of_week, levels = order))

comparison <-bind_rows(mets_data |> mutate(group = "New York Mets"),
                                           all_data |> mutate(group = "Full MLB"))

ggplot(comparison, aes(x = day_of_week, y = attend/1000, fill=group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title="Game Attendance by Day of Week",
    subtitle = '2012 Season Data - Full MLB vs Mets',
    x = "Day",
    y = "Attendance (thousands)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()

```


# FULL MLB FIGURE 7.2

```{r}
order <- c("APR", "MAY", "JUN", "JUL", "AUG", "SEP", "OCT")
mets_data <- mets_data |> mutate(month = factor(month, levels = order,
                                                labels = c("April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October")))

all_data <- all_data |> mutate(month = factor(month, levels = order,
                                                labels = c("April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October")))


comparison <-bind_rows(mets_data |> mutate(group = "New York Mets"),
                       all_data |> mutate(group = "Full MLB"))


ggplot(comparison, aes(x = month, y = attend/1000, fill=group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title="Game Attendance by Month",
    subtitle = '2012 Season Data - Full MLB vs Mets',
    x = "Month",
    y = "Attendance (thousands)"
  ) + theme_cowplot()
```


# FULL MLB TABLE 7.2

```{r}
mets_model <- lm(attend ~ month + day_of_week + bobblehead, data = mets_data)
all_model <- lm(attend ~ month + day_of_week + bobblehead, data = all_data)

summary(mets_model)
summary(all_model)

models_list <- list("Mets" = mets_model,
                    "Full MLB" = all_model)

modelsummary(models_list, stars = TRUE,
             gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "adj.r.squared"))
```


# COMPARISON DAY OF WEEK

```{r}
mets_data_DAY <- mets_data |> group_by(day_of_week) |> summarize("Avg_Mets_day" = mean(attend))
all_data_DAY <- all_data |> group_by(day_of_week) |> summarize("Avg_All_day" = mean(attend))

diffDAY <- left_join(mets_data_DAY, all_data_DAY, by = "day_of_week") |>
  mutate(difference_day = Avg_Mets_day - Avg_All_day) |> arrange(difference_day)
diffDAY
```


# COMPARISON MONTH
```{r}
mets_data_MONTH <- mets_data |> group_by(month) |> summarize("Avg_Mets_month" = mean(attend))
all_data_MONTH <- all_data |> group_by(month) |> summarize("Avg_All_month" = mean(attend))

diffMONTH <- left_join(mets_data_MONTH, all_data_MONTH, by = "month") |>
  mutate(difference = Avg_Mets_month - Avg_All_month) |> arrange(difference)
diffMONTH
```
